benefit_text: The scheme gives cashless hospital coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year. It pays for doctor visits, medicines, tests, surgery, ICU, implants, room and food. It also covers three days before and fifteen days after hospitalisation, all pre‑existing diseases from day one, and has no limit on family size or location.
who_can_apply: Rural families that meet any one of the listed deprivation criteria such as living in a kutcha house, having no adult aged 16 to 59, having a disabled member without an able‑bodied adult, being SC/ST, landless manual labourers, or without shelter can apply. Urban workers in eleven occupational groups like ragpickers, domestic workers, street vendors, construction labourers, sweepers, home‑based artisans, transport workers, shop assistants, electricians, mechanics and washer‑men can also apply.
documents: Age and identity proof such as Aadhaar or PAN card, proof of address, and income or caste certificate are needed. The family’s ration card or other family ID is also required.
how_to_apply: Visit a hospital or Community Service Centre. Give the operator your PM letter, RSBY URN or mobile number. The Arogya Mitra will search the database, verify your Aadhaar and ration card, upload scanned documents and, after approval, issue an e‑card for you and your family.
